resolvedIssues.note: At native256 the finger-end suction cups read as multiple gun barrels. The palm and thumb are unclear; inspecting the mother confirms the silhouette ambiguity. This weakens the gauntlet identity even though the blood-eye suction motif is present.
resolvedIssues.suggestion: Regenerate one closed or half-closed glove with four knuckle masses, a clearly separate thumb, and suction eyes on palm/knuckles rather than long barrel fingers.
resolvedIssues.resolution: Replaced mother and both PNG sizes; independent mother/native256/native128 visual review passed.
